original_card.question: Can a decoder deliver the local paid mass in fewer, larger-rank children (block frame climbs instead of rank-1 to rank-3 steps)?
methods: Find one exact small decoding identity whose frame path climbs in blocks, and price its complete per-call profile.
Bound the best effective child rank achievable for one fixed support alphabet, including copies, frames and restoration.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A per-call local profile, with all copied information, frames and restoration counted, whose ceiling exceeds the selected word's by at least 5%; masked or overcomplete supports must change an assumption of the eight-term all-pairs bound.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected word's per-call local profile, its packing ceiling and the lever table; run levers.py for the ideal budget of the lever you target.
first_step.scope: Positive control and planning budget only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Before any synthesis, write the candidate per-call local profile (and centre charge / unpaid coordinates if changed) and screen it with ceiling.ceiling(); reject it if even the ideal ceiling does not beat the selected word's by your stated margin. Ideal budget: rank-16 delivery is 2.31x (levers.py).
original_card.bottleneck_link: Rank-1 children are about half of recursive cost; the selected word's effective child rank is about 3.9. Larger-rank delivery lowers recursive cost per unit of paid mass.
allowed_variations: One masked, overcomplete or block decoder family with exact labels and supports.
A scoped lower bound on effective rank for one alphabet.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Repacking idle remainders of an unchanged word (covered by the packing ceiling).
Repeating the eight-term all-pairs search inside its proved scope.

actual_scope: Exact separate-term COPY optimum for PR1224's fixed A2 weight plus E6 root basis nine-normal frame on standard P112, allowing arbitrary independent complex per-root kernel shifts.
scope_change_reason: Take the explicit other-normal-family handoff in a8-one-pair-frame-floor rather than synthesize a physical word. This leaves the eight-term hypothesis and allows one factor outside the root code. The scoped COPY obstruction is not a supplier satisfying the original 5-percent gate.
bottleneck_link: Overcomplete decoders are a named escape route from the eight-term COPY floor. An exact support-aware optimum closes or realizes one concrete family left at heuristic search status by PR1224.
stop_rule: First derive the three-variable support/deficiency model and fixed six-term bill. Use exact binary compatibility enumeration, not a bounded coefficient box. Stop construction if its optimistic fully charged conditional moment cannot pass the original five-percent gate. Do not extrapolate to other normal families.
evidence: README.md proves the arbitrary-complex-shift optimum via a complete finite compatibility lemma. RESULT.json records the pair/triple censuses, all-active costs (1,8,8,8,8,9,9,9,9), all 12544 rational identity entries and conditional optimistic moment brackets. independent.py reconstructs geometry with a different binary basis and an independent integer-power budget.
author: Adam Gall
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in mathematical research, implementation, verification and writing.
method_domain: One fixed exact nine-normal frame emitted by the pinned PR1224 construction, standard coordinate-frame P112 puncture; all complex row parameters via their finite exact zero-pattern classes.
optimistic_full_cost_budget: No physical candidate is asserted. If a usable identity appears, hold all 5522 noncentre paid ranks fixed, replace centre profile by its nine support ranks, set centre coverage charge to their sum, retain 896/9 roles per call and rank51 idle ceiling, and set extra gather/frame/restoration/hosting/precision overhead to zero. This is a favorable conditional screen, not a realizability statement. Its ceiling must beat the selected-word ceiling by 5 percent before construction proceeds.
success_falsification: Success is a sharp COPY optimum with rational attaining identity and a finite lemma covering all complex shifts; falsification is a support assignment below the claimed floor or any uncovered shift class. Any physical-success claim additionally requires the full original card gate.

open_questions.question: Can PR1224's A7+A1 nine-normal family lower COPY on a named P112 under arbitrary row shifts?
open_questions.why_it_matters: This is the other explicit subsystem-family escape route, not covered by the fixed A2+E6 theorem.
open_questions.first_step: Compute its fixed-term bill and exact ratio classes before deriving an eight-variable compatibility bound.
open_questions.blocked_by: The three-subspace unique-exception proof does not apply to eight variable supports, and physical realization remains separate.

open_questions.question: Can a specified change of the E6 basis or puncture reduce the fixed and variable costs enough for the original paid-budget gate?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The fixed six terms already cost 52, so changing their support geometry may matter more than optimizing the three shifts.
open_questions.first_step: Compute all fixed support-pair ranks and the elementary pairwise support-union lower bound before synthesis.
open_questions.blocked_by: This result pins one basis and puncture; a changed family needs its own proof and complete physical invoice.
